notes: «وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ» opens the chain: the narration of Abu Bakr al-Hadrami.
«قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» — the Imam named only in the words after the chain is imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the surface is kept as written, and the blessing is left out.
«وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ» opens the chain: the narration of Abu Bakr al-Hadrami.
«قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» — the Imam named only in the words after the chain is imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the surface is kept as written, and the blessing is left out.
«وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ» introduces the narration of Abu Bakr al-Hadrami; «فِي» is not a name.
The Imam is named only in the words after «قال قال», so he is the last link (owner ruling 2); the blessing is not part of the surface.
